text: States the opening condition: rate over the trailing 5 minutes above 2%, at least 500 requests in the window, 3 consecutive evaluations run every 60 seconds.
Shows duplicate suppression: at most one unresolved incident per (service, alert rule), and further breaches are recorded on it without paging.
Shows automatic resolution after 10 consecutive minutes below 1%, and that a later breach opens a new incident.
Shows escalation from primary to secondary to engineering manager at 5-minute intervals, with the manager as the last level, and shows that acknowledgement stops it.
Shows push first with SMS as the fallback, and that a failed page does not stop or delay the escalation clock.
Shows the resolved notice going to everyone who was paged, and escalation stopping if the incident resolves before acknowledgement.
Explains how the two evaluator instances avoid creating duplicate incidents or sending double pages.
Is delivered as a Mermaid sequenceDiagram with short notes before or after it.
